##### Project general facts

Vista del Mar is an exclusive waterfront residential development offering a refined collection of apartments and villas designed to embrace the beauty of coastal living. Comprising just 90 residences, the project features elegant one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments alongside spacious three- and four-bedroom villas, all thoughtfully positioned to capture spectacular views of the waterfront, lush mangroves, the iconic Ferrari World, and the nearby shoreline. Contemporary architecture, clean lines, and expansive glazing create bright, sophisticated living spaces that blend seamlessly with the surrounding natural landscape.

Residents enjoy a lifestyle defined by tranquility, exclusivity, and exceptional connectivity. The project's prime waterfront location offers easy access to beaches, leisure destinations, and key attractions, while its carefully planned residential environment provides the perfect balance between privacy and vibrant city living. Designed to appeal to both homeowners and investors, Vista del Mar delivers an elegant community where luxury, comfort, and scenic surroundings come together effortlessly.

The residences are finished with premium-quality materials, combining elegant wood accents, refined lighting, and contemporary design elements to create warm and sophisticated interiors. Every detail has been carefully selected to enhance both aesthetics and functionality, reflecting modern standards of luxury living. Kitchens come fully equipped with integrated appliances, while optional furnishing packages are available for those seeking a complete turnkey home.

##### Location description and benefits

Yas Island, situated in Abu Dhabi, is a sprawling leisure and entertainment destination that has garnered global acclaim. This man-made island covers approximately 9.6 square kilometers (3.7 square miles) and offers a wide array of world-class attractions. One of its highlights is the renowned Yas Marina Circuit, which hosts the exhilarating Formula 1 Abu Dhabi Grand Prix, attracting racing enthusiasts from around the world.

At the heart of Yas Island is Ferrari World Abu Dhabi, an indoor theme park dedicated to the legendary Italian sports car manufacturer. This extraordinary park enthralls visitors with its thrilling rides, including the record-breaking Formula Rossa roller coaster that accelerates to speeds of up to 240 kilometers per hour (149 miles per hour). Ferrari World also presents captivating exhibits showcasing the brand's history and heritage.

Yas Island's aquatic paradise, Yas Waterworld, offers a refreshing escape from the desert heat. Packed with exhilarating water slides, rides, and pools suitable for all ages, this water park is a must-visit for families and adventure-seekers. Yas Waterworld incorporates Emirati culture and traditions into its design, creating a one-of-a-kind experience that showcases the region's rich heritage.
